name: 五段階で今日の調子を記録
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset: Lighthouse catalog LH13-0003「五段階で今日の調子を記録」, ONE compact horizontal mood selector.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: Image 1 ORIGINAL Insight Timer screenshot controls mood glyph geometry, proportions, curved/flat mouth lines, optical stroke weight, circle-to-glyph ratios, spacing and all fine detail. Use ONLY its top five-face selector, not the analysis chart or lower content. Image 2 is our Japanese FigCraft mock, SECONDARY for Japanese content and overall layout. Image 3 approved bus design, STYLE ONLY: white rounded surface, subtle neutral outline, restrained soft downward shadow. No bus/map content.
Primary request: redesign the exact five-option Japanese selector as a compact white rounded card on pure white canvas, preserving the original five simple circular mood artworks and their meaningful left-to-right color progression. One centered heading above one horizontal row of five equally spaced small circles, each with its centered Japanese label beneath. Keep all five unselected and equal emphasis. No submit, close, arrow, navigation, chart, metric or added text. Logical component 390x178 proportion, full component visible with modest white margin.
Exact text: heading「今日の調子は？」. Labels in order「とてもつらい」「つらい」「ふつう」「よい」「とてもよい」.
Typography locked: Meiryo Bold heading 20px/28px, metadata labels Meiryo Regular 12px/16px (not bold), zero tracking; main ink #1D1D1D. Preserve original mock's one-line label wrapping. No English.
Glyph detail: NO eyes, eyebrows, cheeks or emoji faces. Each face is a simple pale circular disk containing one centered thick rounded mouth stroke. First deep-blue downward frown, second light-blue shallow frown, third amber horizontal short line, fourth light-green shallow smile, fifth deep-green smile. Precisely retain the source mouth curves, stroke thickness and optical centering, rather than inventing generic face icons. Original art colors are semantic stages, not decoration. Keep their corresponding very pale small circle fills, confined to the five icon disks. No green-washed card, mint background or selection. No bright gloss, heavy rim or 3D.
Surface: #FFFFFF canvas and card, 24px logical card corners, fine neutral outline and subtle downward shadow. Compact readable composition, orderly baselines and balanced spacing. Preserve five choices and their exact content. Output is a visual raster candidate, not a native editable component or application.
reviewNotes: 原画全体・5つの表情クロップ・日本語モックを実見。原画の口線の形・太さ・円と図像の比率を主参照、モックを副参照とした。青から緑の意味ある五段階色を小さな原画図像内のみ保持、支持アイコンをランダム配色していない。生成結果実見:問いと5ラベルの日本語・順序・無選択・目なし口線・白面・淡い円・見切れなしを確認。厳密な原画ピクセル/Meiryo実体は未証明。reviewedは画像候補のエージェント視覚レビューのみ、所有者承認/編集性/実装ではない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
